title: Display Button Links - Call To Action
text:
## Display Button Links - Call To Action
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046511
Navigate to Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage >> Top Hero Section >> Search Box / Call to Action  > Click on Select Call to Action.
Select the Display Button Links option:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12117399496/original/kQ7tjjTKSNvFkKPxj7q8rKyvy2Qq5jd0Ag.png?1668697531 | alt: ]
This will activate the following fields:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12117399521/original/IDZBKnKEtC6KR6_jtwIN8F2OBFXbpN1xTQ.png?1668697559 | alt: ]
Button Text: Add the text to be displayed. Example: Join Now
Button URL: Add the permalink that the button will link to. Example /join
Button Class: Choose the type of button.
This is what a homepage looks like when using three buttons:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12117399713/original/n_dslZH59RQ1xYJUyezeNXv7flZXYUwynw.png?1668697730 | alt: ]
Important Note: This section support classes like fontawesome class, hence the preferred icons can be used as shown below:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12117399869/original/sRAC2wZ1V9-4duKChKqvH_XqfQtjheHsIg.png?1668697897 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12117399883/original/xEWrkB1-Iymm-7-P0Hq_WgU_D1udkHiojA.png?1668697914 | alt: ]
